text:
Maya R.: Hey team — opening a small PR to tidy the onboarding runbook / codelab. It trims the steps, clarifies the auth flow, and swaps a couple deprecated env vars. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4521

Kevin L.: Thanks — can you split the Python and TypeScript changes into two PRs? makes reviews faster.

Maya R.: Yep, splitting now. Main goals: reduce setup time to <2m, remove REDWOOD_API_KEY_OLD references, and add a clear note about Node/Python versions.

Samira P.: For the TS snippet, can we recommend the SDK client instead of raw fetch? e.g.
```
import {Redwood} from '@redwood/inference';
const client = new Redwood({apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY});
```
Feels safer for beginners.

Aaron G.: I can run the codelab locally and validate. Which Node should we pin in package.json — 18 or 20 LTS?

Lina K.: We standardized on 20 across examples. Add an engines field and call out Node >=20 in prereqs.

Maya R.: Great. I'll split the PRs tonight. Lina, could you push the tiny change to the Python snippet (docstring tweak)?

Lina K.: Done — pushed branch docs/py-snippet-fix. CI shows a lint failure though.

Docs Bot: CI / docs-lint check failed for docs/guide/getting-started.md: trailing-whitespace. See https://ci.redwood.dev/12345

Kevin L.: trivial — I'll apply the whitespace fix and re-run.

Aaron G.: I ran the codelab inside a container (Node 20 + Python 3.11). Found one missing env note in README, patched locally and posted results: https://gist.github.com/aarong/abcd1234

Maya R.: Excellent. After CI is green can we trigger the "first-run" smoke pipeline? @Aaron G. can you kick it off?

Aaron G.: Yep scheduling now.

Docs Bot: smoke-test pipeline started for PR 4521.

Kevin L.: Once smoke passes I'll merge the TS PR. Maya — can you add a 1-line release blurb?

Maya R.: Drafting: "Onboarding codelab: updated auth snippets, Node >=20 requirement, and reduced setup time." I'll paste it into the PR desc.

Aaron G.: smoke-test passed :tada: — no regressions.

Kevin L.: Merging both PRs now.

Maya R.: Thanks all! I'll follow up to bump the quickstart sidebar link after deploy. :rocket:
